name: outlook-snds
description: Access Outlook.com Smart Network Data Services (SNDS) IP Data and IP Status reports via the OAuth-secured REST API.
long_description: Exposes the Microsoft Outlook.com Smart Network Data Services (SNDS) REST API as MCP tools. Sign in once with your Microsoft account (OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE flow with a loopback localhost redirect, using the SNDS portal's public client against the consumers tenant); tokens are cached and refreshed automatically. Then pull the IP Data report (per-IP traffic and reputation metrics: RCPT/DATA commands, message recipients, spam filter result, complaint rate, trap hits, sample HELO/MAIL, comments) for the most recent day or a specific date and IP, and the IP Status report (IPs in an abnormal state such as Blocked / Bot / Junked).

tools.name: snds_authenticate
tools.description: Sign in to Outlook SNDS via Microsoft-account OAuth (opens the browser).

tools.name: snds_auth_status
tools.description: Show current SNDS sign-in status, account, and token expiry.

tools.name: snds_sign_out
tools.description: Delete the cached SNDS tokens (sign out).

tools.name: get_data_report
tools.description: Get the SNDS IP Data report (most recent, or by date and optional IPv4).

tools.name: get_ip_status
tools.description: Get the SNDS IP Status report for the IPs you own.
